# Capacitor

> Capacitor allows you to easily convert between FCPXML versions.

- [Capacitor](https://capacitor.fcp.cafe/readme.md): Capacitor
- [Buy on Mac App Store](https://capacitor.fcp.cafe/buy.md): Capacitor is a one-time payment of USD$19.99 on the Mac App Store.
- [Educational Pricing](https://capacitor.fcp.cafe/educational.md): Educational institutions can get a 50% discount when they purchase 20 or more copies through Apple School Manager.
- [System Requirements](https://capacitor.fcp.cafe/system-requirements.md): Capacitor requires macOS Sonoma (or later).

- [Release Notes](https://capacitor.fcp.cafe/release-notes.md): 🎉 Released:
- [Uninstall](https://capacitor.fcp.cafe/uninstall.md): To uninstall Capacitor, simply drag the application to the trash/bin.
